lines.l: I have tried in vain, never no more to call your name, when you left you broke my heart, because I never thought we'd part.
Every hour in the day, you'll hear me say, oh, baby, come home.
Baby, won't you please come home?
Never no more to speak your name
When you left you broke my heart
Because I never thought we'd part
Oh, my dear, I'm so lonely
